name: Coal coke dust is a catalyst

pages.text: This is the part that confuses everyone, so read it carefully.$(br2)Every batch $(item)uses one Coal Coke Dust$(). Then, $(item)90% of the time$(), one dust is given $(item)back to the vat input$(), not to the output.

So when you watch the vat:$(br2)$(li)the coke dust count $(item)usually stays the same$() from one batch to the next,$(li)it $(item)drops by 1 about once every 10 batches$(),$(li)coke dust $(item)never comes out$() of the output side.
Nothing is broken, and the dust is not being duplicated or lost: it behaves like a catalyst. A stack of 64 dust lasts for about 640 batches, that is 640 ingots of steel.

Keep a few dust in the input and top it up from time to time, or leave a funnel feeding it slowly. If the input slot is full when a dust comes back, it goes to the output instead so it is never deleted.
JEI shows the same thing on the recipe: the dust is marked as returned to the vat input, with about 10% used up per cycle.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
